nodes.name: Webhook Dispatch
nodes.notes: Fired by POST /api/acquisition/sends on every approved batch ({send_ids}). The payload is advisory — the fetch below re-reads status='approved' from the ledger, so replays and missed pings are both safe.

nodes.name: Every 15 min sweep
nodes.notes: Fallback sweep so a missed webhook only delays a send, never drops it.

nodes.name: Fetch approved sends
nodes.notes: Service-role read. Embeds the lead so suppression checks need no second call.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'suppressed', error: 'lead unreachable or opted out at dispatch time' }) }}

nodes.name: Send via Resend
nodes.notes: Credential 'Resend API' (httpHeaderAuth): header 'Authorization: Bearer <resend key>'. continueOnFail so one bounce doesn't strand the rest of the batch.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify($json.ok ? { status: 'sent', resend_id: $json.resend_id, sent_at: $json.now } : { status: 'failed', error: $json.error }) }}

nodes.name: Mark lead contacted
nodes.notes: Status filter keeps 'conversation'/'closed_*' leads untouched — dispatch never regresses a lead's stage.
